title: Extract the 3x-duplicated 4-path file-candidate search in epic_25_story_25_20_locale_theme_test.dart into one helper
why: The identical 4-item candidate list (lib/app/learning_tracker_app.dart, learning_tracker/lib/app/..., lib/main.dart, learning_tracker/lib/main.dart) plus a near-identical linear-search-and-read loop is pasted three times in one file: once in the AC2/AC3 setUpAll (which caches the result as mainSource) and again inside two separate AC9 tests that re-scan and re-read the same files from disk instead of reusing mainSource. A future path change has to be applied in three places in this file alone; missing one silently leaves a structural AC check reading stale content without failing loudly.
recommendation: Factor the candidate list and search loop into one shared helper (or simply reuse the cached mainSource from the AC2/AC3 group) and call it from all three sites.
acceptance_criteria: only one copy of the 4-path candidate list remains in the file
AC9's two tests reuse the same source read as AC2/AC3 instead of re-scanning disk
